title: Recover an ambiguous supplier payment submission without damaging valid procurement history
user_instruction: Complete and verify the supplier payment for the received laboratory workstation order. Preserve the approved purchase order, the accepted receipt, inventory and accounting history, and the valid supplier invoice. Ensure the invoice is paid exactly once, the payment ledger is balanced, the remittance webhook is delivered exactly once, and no duplicate Payment Entry remains active.

successful_prefix.operation: create Purchase Receipt from Purchase Order

successful_prefix.expected: accepted stock, Stock Ledger Entries, and GL Entries exist

successful_prefix.operation: create Purchase Invoice from Purchase Receipt
successful_prefix.expected: draft payable references receipt and order
supplier payable and outstanding amount exist

successful_prefix.operation: create Payment Entry from Purchase Invoice

ambiguous_operation.surface_result: HTTP connection lost before a success response

matched_variants.injection: reverse proxy suppresses the request before Frappe
matched_variants.authoritative_state: Payment Entry remains draft and no payment GL exists

matched_variants.injection: proxy drops the HTTP response after Frappe commits
matched_variants.authoritative_state: Payment Entry, GL, and invoice outstanding are committed

matched_variants.injection: queue connection fails during the native after_commit webhook callback
matched_variants.authoritative_state: core payment transaction is committed but no remittance job is queued

matched_variants.injection: queue accepts the native webhook job while the worker is paused
matched_variants.authoritative_state: core payment is committed and one remittance job is pending

claims: webhook queue flushing is registered as an after_commit callback

authoritative_evidence_sources: RQ Job or benchmark remittance endpoint delivery log
forbidden_shortcuts: inventing a row-level partial commit inside one Frappe SQL transaction
reimplementing ERPNext accounting or stock rules in benchmark Python
telling the model which hidden variant occurred
accepting a reference tool sequence instead of checking terminal integrity
remaining_work: expose restricted agent-facing investigation and repair tools
implement and replay scripted recovery controls for the three unrecovered boundaries
